rappel_detail.anchor: natural: slung block, horn or krummholz, built by the party; old webbing has been reported
rappel_detail.station: The crux notch at about 7,300-7,400 ft on the north ridge.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional: many parties downclimb the notch unroped on exposed but adequate holds; others make a single rappel of roughly 30 m (100 ft).

set.rappels: 1 optional rappel of roughly 30 m at the crux notch on the north ridge; many parties downclimb it
set.descent: Reverse the north ridge: downclimb the gully above the notch, rappel or downclimb the crux notch, and retrace the approach.
